items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Now Has The Largest U.S. Dividend ETF
items.summary: The Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (NYSE:SCHD) has become the largest dividend-focused ETF in the U.S. market. The fund's new status highlights investor interest in Schwab's low-cost, dividend-oriented approach to portfolio income. This positions Charles Schwab's asset management arm as a central player in U.S. dividend ETF product design and distribution.
